notes: Envelope study (right): investment area extruded to the MPZP limits — white lines mark the minimum roof heights (18 m outside A, 35 m in A). Any roof below these lines is illegal: no low pavilions, no low link blocks.
Maximum envelope ≈ 2,544 m² × 25 m + 1,184 m² × 45 m — far above the programme (≈13,500 m² GFA), so the design task is subtraction: where to open courtyards, gardens and the Słowackiego 5 light gap.
Shadow test (SW sun) already shows the tower's long shadow falling across the bridgehead square (north) — favourable: no residential windows there.
Concept agents are computing full area schedules and Sejmik-floor layouts; the jury (5 personas) starts as soon as all five dossiers are complete.
Background: photomatch solver (F.17.A/B) and 3D context builder (neighbours LOD3, bridge, terrain, trees) running.
